answers: Backups are created by `pg_dump` run inside the container via `docker exec`, with output streamed to a `.dump` file on the host.
The script deletes files matching the backup names with `find ... -mtime +6 -delete`, after each successful backup, so only roughly the newest 7 are kept.
The restore test runs in a throwaway container using the same image as production, named app-db-restore-test, not on the production database.
